newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares score another all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares score another all-time high.

text.p: Norwegian shares scored an all-time closing high for the third time this week on Wednesday supported by low domestic interest rates and foreign impulses, dealers said.
The index ended 0.21 percent higher at 894.28 crowns in healthy trade worth 815 million crowns.

"The market is still factoring in low Norwegian interest rates and there is buying interest in consumer shares," one dealer said. "Also, the market was helped because the dollar firmed. But otherwise it was a mixed bag today."
The industry and insurance indexes both rose but the shipping and banking indexes fell.
Another dealer said the German DAX index, which ended at an all-time record closing high on Wednesday, helped boost Oslo trading.
Among blue chip stock, shipping group Bergesen A shares were flat on the eve of the company's nine-month results on Thursday. But the B share dropped 1.50 crowns to 143 crowns.
Insurance group Storebrand, oil company Saga Petroleum and metals maker Elkem all rose, but industrial conglomerates Norsk Hydro and Kvaerner both finished lower.
